propositions: The --review flag on edit must parse as valueless without consuming the next token and invoke review_plan after the EDIT event commits, mapping verdict to exit status per ADR-0040 disposition codes (0 PASS, 1 BLOCK, 2 INDETERMINATE, 11 retryable).

The --review flag on claim must invoke claim_gate_check and review_plan only when the gate applies; it proceeds to claim only on PASS verdict, and exits with the review result on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable without invoking the claim core.

Both --review implementations must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import from _llm_commands, never hold the store lock during review, and let review_plan exceptions propagate through the standard CLI error path.
When claim --review detects the gate does not apply, it prints a one-line skip notice and proceeds with the claim without review; the flag is never silently ignored.

The --review flags must be documented in help sources and exit-codes.md to state non-atomicity against concurrent reconvergence and reference review-plan --status; the flags must not propagate through the parent-first cascade.
